prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is active on your screen. Use your system tray icon anytime to open settings or manage interactions."]
1: ["Select Your Companion Archetype", "Swipe to explore companion personality types and pick the desktop vibe that matches your workflow."]
2: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Your companion's name and personality traits have been registered to your device."]
3: ["Save Your Created Pet to Account", "Sign in now to sync your new desktop pet across devices and preserve your setup."]
4: ["Verify Companion Adoption Details", "Review your companion settings below before generating your live desktop avatar."]
5: ["Assembling Desktop Avatar...", "Your companion is being rendered and prepared for your desktop layout."]
6: ["Signing in automatically syncs and restores any pets previously linked to your account.", "Your existing pet data is safe and will reload automatically upon login."]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Your pet is active! You unlocked a starter accessory pack to customize your companion.", "Starter Toy & Snack Unlocked"]
8: ["Select How Your Pet Interacts on Desktop", "Choose 'Quiet Companion' for ambient desktop company, or 'Active Buddy' for interactive focus breaks and games.", "Continue Path"]
9: []
